title: From Waste to Discovery: Recycling High-Scored Unexposed Candidates in Taobao Feed Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.05997v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Helping users discover new interests is vital to the long-term health of industrial recommender systems, yet the usual remedy, boosting exposure of under-explored (discovery) content, often backfires in production. We report URED (Unexposed Recycling for Efficient Discovery), a training-free recall-stage system serving Taobao feed recommendation at Alibaba for over six months to tens of millions of daily active users. It rests on a production-validated insight: naive boosting fails because it injects cold, information-poor candidates that rankers systematically over-estimate, buying no discovery gain while risking engagement. Items scored highly but never exposed (signals industrial pipelines routinely discard) form a pool that is both relevant and reliably predictable. Over a 30-day horizon URED aggregates them and re-injects at recall time through a lightweight pipeline spanning offline storage, distributed aggregation, and low-latency

translated_title: 从废料到发现：在淘宝信息流推荐中回收高分未曝光候选物品
translated_abstract: 帮助用户发现新兴趣对于工业推荐系统的长期健康发展至关重要，然而常见的补救措施——提升探索不足（探索性）内容的曝光——在生产环境中往往适得其反。我们提出了URED（Unexposed Recycling for Efficient Discovery，未曝光回收高效发现），这是一个无需训练的召回阶段系统，已在阿里巴巴的淘宝信息流推荐中为千万级日活跃用户服务超过六个月。该系统基于一个经生产环境验证的洞察：朴素的曝光提升之所以失败，是因为它注入了冷启动、信息贫乏的候选物品，而排序器会系统性地高估这些物品，不仅无法带来发现收益，还会损害用户参与度。那些得分很高但从未曝光的物品（工业流水线通常会丢弃的信号）构成了一个既相关又可被可靠预测的候选池。在30天的时间窗口内，URED聚合这些物品，并在召回阶段通过一个涵盖离线存储、分布式聚合和低延迟服务的轻量级流水线将其重新注入。
tldr: 论文提出无需训练的召回阶段系统URED，通过回收工业推荐流水线中通常被丢弃的高分未曝光候选物品并在召回阶段重新注入，在淘宝信息流推荐中高效帮助用户发现新兴趣，避免了传统曝光提升策略因冷启动候选被排序器高估而损害参与度的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes URED, a training-free recall-stage system that recycles high-scored but never-exposed candidates—routinely discarded by industrial pipelines—and re-injects them at recall time, enabling efficient interest discovery in Taobao feed recommendation while avoiding the engagement risks of naive exposure boosting.
